about: Aurelia is an original fantasy setting created for this template. The Starbound Realm imagines scattered islands, woodland settlements and forgotten ruins, connected by the journeys of small adventuring parties. Its stories are sample editorial content, ready to be replaced by verified information for your own game.

This atlas demonstrates a complete guide-site layout without pretending that its preview topics are published articles. The first-session guide is available in five languages. The other entries preserve the reference layout and show where future, properly researched content can appear. No release date, price or online service is claimed for this fictional world.

classes.title: Sentinel
classes.description: A patient shield-bearing explorer. Practise steady positioning, measured attacks and keeping a safe route open for friends.

classes.title: Wayfinder
classes.description: A light-footed trail reader. Learn to keep your distance, observe landmarks and choose a clear path through unfamiliar terrain.

classes.title: Spellweaver
classes.description: An imagined elemental scholar. Experiment with timing and distance while leaving enough space to react to a changing encounter.

classes.title: Starwarden
classes.description: A thoughtful party companion. Coordinate with friends, watch the group’s positioning and make time for a careful recovery.

regions.title: Starfall Isles
regions.description: Wind-swept islands linked by old bridges and unfamiliar trails. An original setting for small ruins and a first expedition.

regions.title: Valley of the Amber Leaves
regions.description: An imagined autumn valley with quiet woodland settlements and overgrown ruins. Observe the ground and take each path slowly.

faq: Aurelia is an original fictional world made for this template. Its adventure notes demonstrate how a guide site can present its content.
No release is claimed. Names, regions and character roles on this template are original demonstration content.
Only complete MDX articles open as guides. A Preview label identifies a topic that has no published article yet.
Can I read the first-session guide?
Yes. Open the walkthrough library and choose Aurelia Best Start to read the complete original sample article.
Does the atlas show live server data?
No. Tool cards are labelled previews. This template does not connect to a server-status or player-count service.
English, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish and Simplified Chinese share the same layout and independent content.
